ontology.note: Design alignment to GenericInputConfiguration; not a claim that current receipts emit this type.

changes.description: On the standard Inspector and dialog (experiments 186, 200): Name, input, one sentence and Configure…, which opens the Input data editor for points held here, or, for points read from a table, a dialog naming the longitude, latitude, record ID and label columns, applied together. The table's columns are no longer set one by one on the panel. Its points can also be read by a step that takes a table, as rows of their attributes.

evidence.note: Shared-input unit and Chromium regressions cover migration, data preservation, editor saving and offline EYE results; repository gate remains authoritative.
